canonical_title: Marvell and Lumentum agree $115 billion AI optical connectivity acquisition
treatment: Definitive all-stock acquisition agreement covered; do not repeat speculation or generic commentary. Reinclude only for regulatory/shareholder approval, deal term revision, cancellation, completion, or concrete product/production integration milestones.
known_facts: Joint Business Wire announcement published 2026-11-02 07:05 EST (21:05 JST) confirms a definitive all-stock agreement for Marvell to acquire Lumentum.
Implied enterprise value approximately $115 billion, equity value approximately $102.54 billion; Lumentum holders receive 4.5 Marvell shares per share and about 33% of the combined company.
The firms intend to combine Marvell's networking/custom silicon with Lumentum's lasers, optical components and manufacturing; claimed combined TAM $550 billion is a company estimate.
Both boards approved; shareholder and regulatory approvals remain required, and expected close is H1 calendar 2028.
reinclude_only_if: Shareholders or regulators approve, condition, or reject the transaction.
Exchange ratio, valuation, financing, or expected close changes materially.
Official production milestones or quantified benefits of integrated optical technologies are announced.
notes: NEW 2026-11-02 night. Prior October 28 deal speculation is not counted as the hard delta; the November 2 definitive agreement is.
